title: Encode the 21 program stopping conditions as machine-checkable predicates and resolve the PR-ONLY contradiction
question: Amend condition 13 to a PR-merge-plus-rollback-rehearsal equivalent, or accept the program can never satisfy its own stopping rule?
answer: All 21 stopping conditions are encoded as individually evaluable predicates returning TRUE, FALSE or NOT-CHECKED with an evidence pointer and a settling-probe cost. NOT-CHECKED is counted separately and is never folded into a pass (live TRUE=1 FALSE=0 NOT-CHECKED=20; PROGRAM-INCOMPLETE). Condition 13 as written remains UNSATISFIABLE-AS-WRITTEN under PR-ONLY. The owner ruling is already recorded at OWNER-DECISIONS.md REL-0003 / receipts/REL-0003.json (not re-asked): the live predicate is a merged PR plus green REL-0004/REL-0005/REL-0006 receipts, evaluated by the same generic evaluator (live verdict NOT-CHECKED). SUCCESS:CC-0015
